00054   TYPE :: alwd_exstate
00055      ! Purpose: This type stores data for the allowed, discrete transitions
00056      ! of a species (i.e. excitations). The variable names come from Porter,
00057      ! Jackman, Green 1976 and the formula with which these are designed to be
00058      ! used can be found in Jackman, Garvey, and Green 1977.
00059      !
00060      ! For more detail on the physical meaning of these values, see the above
00061      ! reference.
00062      CHARACTER(len=20) :: termsym_alwd !term symbol for the state in LaTeX format
00063      DOUBLE PRECISION  :: wj_alwd !Excitation energy in eV
00064      DOUBLE PRECISION  :: fj_alwd !oscillator strength
00065      DOUBLE PRECISION  :: cj_alwd !determined from the oscillator strength
00066      DOUBLE PRECISION  :: alpha_alwd !fitting parameter
00067      DOUBLE PRECISION  :: beta_alwd !fitting parameter
00068   END TYPE alwd_exstate
